text:
mara: Heads up 10: Acme SI asked whether we need raw HSM key ceremony logs or a vendor attestation for the marketplace listing. Also asked about how to submit redacted pen reports and scan exports.
omar: Short: we accept vendor attestation + key policy export. Raw ceremonies = no, unless under NDA. We'll presign attestation + questionnaire; partner uploads scans and redacted pen.
lucy: Security notes: require redaction map CSV (original token -> placeholder) plus the redacted file. No screenshots-only redactions. If pen includes exploit PoCs, require separate NDA before we accept those sections.
infra-bot: Presign pattern (example):
```
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket rw-marketplace-ingest --key acme/2026-04-01/pen-redacted.pdf --expires-in 3600
```
We tag with `marketplace:acme` and `artifact:pen`. Presign tokens valid for 1h; partner get 7-day upload window via refresh endpoint.
mara: Retention?
lucy: Default retention 12 months for full artifacts, metadata 3 years. Legal exceptions possible.
omar: Proposed owners: Partnerships (omar) = partner comms + presign handoff; Eng-Infra = bucket + tags + object-lock; Security (lucy) = redaction checklist + artifact acceptance; Legal = NDA + retention.
mara: OK. Final ask: acceptable scan formats?
lucy: Accept: Nessus (.nessus/.xml), Qualys CSV, Trivy/Clair JSON. Proprietary formats require exported CSV/JSON.
infra-bot: Action items:
- Omar: draft partner email + attach checklist (due today)
- Eng-Infra: create presign bucket + refresh endpoint (due tomorrow)
- Lucy: publish redaction map template (due today)
mara: I'll review the draft before it goes out. Thanks. :thumbsup:
